ValidationRule.description: Accepted and denied appeals must have a value in the decisions support notes field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Appeal_Stage__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Appeal_Stage__c, "Denied"), ISPICKVAL(Appeal_Stage__c, "Accepted") ), ISBLANK( Decision_Support_Notes__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Accepted and Denied requests must have decision support notes.
